messages:
Ryan (AE): Kicking off AvalonBank POC — high level asks: SSO via SAML, SCIM delta provisioning, RBAC mapping (AD groups -> roles), strict domain proofing/tenant ownership, and pricing for a 4-week POC. I attached their security questionnaire (link). Who can own the tech lead from our side?

Anya (Solutions Eng): I can own the POC on our side. Quick Q: For SCIM do they expect delta sync or full re-provision each run? Also what rate do they expect? Do they require nested group sync? :thinking:

Ryan (AE): They said delta preferred, roughly 50k users total, nested groups yes. They want role mapping to reflect AD group hierarchy.

Jordan (Platform Eng): For 50k users we should recommend incremental SCIM with pagination + delta token. We support nested groups but need confirmation on max group depth. We'll need a test org with ~10k users to validate throughput and patch sizes. Also SCIM token rotation plan needed.

Anya (Solutions Eng): Agreed. Suggest throttles for the POC: 200 rps burst, sustained 60 rps for SCIM writes. For the stress test we can spin up a Dedicated pool for one week. Example config snippet: 
```
scim.max_requests_per_sec: 60
scim.batch_size: 100
```

Marta (Security): Security questionnaire flagged: data residency (EU), KMS/HSM for keys, retention of audit logs, SCIM access token lifecycle, SAML metadata signing, and proof of SOC2. We'll need to provide our SOC2 cert and a redlined DPA. Ryan — can you surface the legal contact?

Alex (Sales Ops): I can pull the SOC2 PDF and DPA template. Pricing note: 4-week POC with a 1-week dedicated performance run often covered by POC credits — AE approval required. If they want Dedicated after POC, we typically require a 3-month minimum reserved capacity commit. I'll draft numbers and options (hosted vs dedicated vs private connector).

Ryan (AE): @Alex please draft the quote. @Marta legal contact is Lina in Sales Legal (I cc'd her via email). Also need pricing for hosted + private connector (VPC peering + IP allowlist).

Jordan (Platform Eng): RBAC notes: we can map SCIM groups to Redwood roles. Nested groups map to multiple role assignments. When using prefix-based mapping we strip domain qualifiers. Edge case: groups with >1000 members may exceed a single SCIM patch; we'll need batching. Example mapping: 
```
group: 'avalon-engineers' -> role: 'editor'
```

Anya (Solutions Eng): For domain proofing they requested org-level verification (DNS TXT). We support DNS TXT and email-based validation, but enterprise legal usually requires DNS TXT steps. I'll send the instruction doc.

Marta (Security): Also confirm encryption at rest: AES-256, TLS 1.2+ for in-transit. They asked about customer-managed keys (optional). We should also document logs retention (90 days default, extendable). Do we rotate SCIM tokens automatically? Need to provide recommended lifecycle.

Ryan (AE): Next steps: 1) @Anya send POC test org details and SCIM sample payload to their IdP team; 2) @Jordan schedule perf run for week 3 (dedicated pool); 3) @Alex produce preliminary POC quote by EOD tomorrow; 4) @Marta prepare answers to the top 12 security Qs. I'll sync with the client Friday 10am CET.

Anya (Solutions Eng): Uploaded SCIM sample to shared drive: https://redwood.example.com/avalon-poc/scim-sample.json — contains delta payload examples and group nesting cases.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Dedicated pool requested for project avalonbank-poc on 2024-10-21 — awaiting approval :gear:

Alex (Sales Ops): Draft quote done — sent to Ryan for approval. Included options: hosted POC (credit-covered), 1-week dedicated perf run (charged unless approved), private connector add-on (one-time infra fee).

Marta (Security): I'll attach answers to the security questionnaire in this thread once reviewed. Quick flag: they asked about access logging retention >1 year — will propose extended retention as paid add-on.

Ryan (AE): Great — thanks everyone. Ping if blockers arise. :thumbsup:
